description: In the final reply, briefly report the verified result in the user's language and offer one relevant optional next step; missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically. Saved links let friends join without accounts. Create a new saved lesgooo plan and its first participant. Returns shareable links, private participant credentials and missing_details. Title and name are optional: omissions use temporary Event/Organizer labels, allowing the requested action to complete before missing details are collected in chat. Explicitly supplied fields are not missing. Existing organizer details can later be completed through credential-bound join_plan and the same plan title through update_event, with data preserved. Does not send invitations or notifications. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

request_id.description: Optional UUID v4 for atomic creation. An identical UUID and identical fields (including omissions) replay the same creation; a changed payload is rejected.

title.description: User-supplied short plan name (max 120 chars). Omitted when unknown; temporary Event label until collected after the requested action.

your_name.description: User-supplied participant name (max 80 chars). Omitted when unknown; temporary Organizer participant until their name is collected after the requested action.
